title: LinkedIn course: how Adam Robinson grew from 4K to 100K+ followers and built RB2B to $3M ARR
summary: Adam lays out a six-step LinkedIn framework: develop an authentic story, perfect your profile, write hook-driven posts, run connect campaigns, build community through comments, then add video. His core claim is that personal brands beat company pages because people connect with people, and that organic content gives small companies free ads that big competitors can't buy.

principles.text: Personal profiles beat company pages: people do business with people, so show up as your authentic self.
principles.quote: Today, people do business with people, not companies. People are on social media to connect with people, not companies.

principles.text: Great organic content works as free ads that large companies must pay for, leveling the field with a solo founder.
principles.quote: If you can create great organic social content that your target market loves and consumes daily, those are free ads. Large companies have to pay for those impressions.

principles.text: Be clear, consistent and constantly reinforce your story; vulnerability and candor cut through where big brands can't.
principles.quote: If you can say things to LinkedIn that you would say to your spouse behind closed doors, it will do better than anything any large company could ever post.

principles.text: Stand out by being polarizing: sit between mainstream and crazy so your side loves you and the other side hates you.
principles.quote: If you can find a sweet spot between mainstream and crazy where people on your side love you but on the other side hate you, that's where the prolific content lives.

principles.text: Pick content pillars tangential to the problem you solve, so your prospects share those problems too.
principles.quote: I like to focus on topics that are tangential to the problem that you're solving. Meaning, all the prospects who have the problem you're solving also have the problems you're talking about.

principles.text: Be patient after connecting: let prospects see your content for about 60 days before asking for a meeting.
principles.quote: Don't start pitching. Wait 60 days. This patience is what will separate you from the people who connect and then pitch 10 minutes later.
